facts.fact: The Deputy Minister of Health held a coordination meeting with Vodafone, the communications ministry and the universal health insurance authority on digital integration to lay the foundations for the national digital health strategy, and the ministry spokesman said it stressed activating the health information exchange (HIE), with a wider workshop proposed.

note: The meeting date is not given, so as_of is the published date; the article describes coordination, with no system stated to be in service.

facts.fact: Daily News Egypt reports the Ministry of Health and Population proposed an Egypt Smart Healthcare Platform to connect health facilities and share patient histories between them, and officials discussed launching a pilot for the first phase; no cost or timetable was disclosed.

systems.platform: MTS and Inspur discussed as partners

systems.system: GAHAR digital institutional development (smart applications, unified information infrastructure)
systems.owner: General Authority for Healthcare Accreditation and Regulation

note: MoU automates GAHAR's own operations; data exchange with UHIA, EHA and MoHP is an aim, with no exchange system described.

facts.fact: The Egypt Healthcare Authority states an electronic referral system from primary healthcare units and centres to higher levels of service has been implemented in the universal health insurance provinces.

systems.system: Unified electronic medical record (4.5 million electronic health records)
Modular UHIS information system (procurement, beneficiary, provider, claims modules)

note: States procurement module rolled out and beneficiary, provider and claims modules not yet; no exchange between systems stated.

facts.fact: The National Health Compact commits Egypt to integrating databases between the Ministry of Social Solidarity and the Universal Health Insurance Authority to enrol Takaful and Karama beneficiaries into UHIS by 2030.

The Compact commits to pass a Telemedicine Law by 2030 codifying cross-platform interoperability standards under UHIS, and states digital transformation of health facilities remains a work in progress.

systems.owner: Ministry of Social Solidarity; Universal Health Insurance Authority

note: The passages file holds only the title page and licence text of the strategy; no paragraph states anything about health systems exchanging data.

facts.fact: Aldawla News reports the Ministry of Health's assistant minister for information systems presented the national health information exchange (HIE) platform, which links all service providers and creates a unified electronic health record per citizen, to D-8 health ministers.

eHealth reports that the Ministry of Health and Population signed an agreement with eHealth in June 2025 to operate the National Digital Health System, including integration with the Universal Health Insurance System and interoperability of data across public, regulatory and private stakeholders.

note: Single platforms and a draft health-database law; no data exchange between systems is stated.
